sub_indicators.text: Registration of entire population: registration of entire population
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's Digital Transformation Strategy sets a target of 99.9% of people in Africa holding a digital legal identity by 2030, from birth.
criteria: A source from the past three years counts fewer than a third of the population holding a national ID.
A source from the past three years counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID.
A source from the past three years counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID.
A source from the past three years counts 99.9% of the population or more holding a national ID.
A source from the past three years puts birth registration at all births and death registration at 80% or more.

gaps.4: No source found since October 2023 puts birth registration at all births and deaths at 80% or more.
gaps.3: No source found since October 2023 counts 99.9% of the population or more holding a national ID.
gaps.2: No source found since October 2023 says: do two-thirds hold one.
gaps.1: No source found since October 2023 says: does a third of the population hold a national id.

ladder.empty: Nothing found counts the people holding a national ID.
ladder.unplaced: Nothing found since October 2023 counts the people holding a national ID.
